title: Household pest prevention by cleanliness
summary: Non-toxic first steps for reducing insects and rodents around food, waste, and water.
content: Pests follow food, water, shelter, and hidden waste. Before poison, fix the conditions attracting them: sealed food, covered waste, dry floors, cleaned spills, blocked holes, and regular trash movement. Poison can harm children, pets, and food safety when used badly. Keep prevention boring and consistent.
steps: Keep trash covered and away from sleeping areas.
Close small entry gaps when safe.
Inspect at the same time daily.
warnings: Do not ignore droppings near food storage.
